steps.title: Observe the incoming wave
steps.student_goal: Observe the electric field vectors before any optical element is inserted.
success_criteria: Student observes both transverse field components.
Student identifies the wave propagation direction.
Student describes polarization using field-vector motion instead of object motion.

steps.title: Rotate a linear polarizer
steps.student_goal: Rotate a linear polarizer and observe how transmitted amplitude and orientation change.
success_criteria: Student rotates the polarizer transmission axis.
Student observes transmitted field vectors align with the polarizer axis.
Student connects reduced amplitude with projection onto the transmission axis.

steps.title: Add a quarter-wave plate
steps.student_goal: Insert a quarter-wave plate and reason about relative phase and polarization state.
success_criteria: Student observes a change in field-vector motion after the quarter-wave plate.
Student explains that the plate adds a relative phase shift between components.
Student distinguishes circular or elliptical polarization from linear polarization.
